name: vulnerable-weak-stack-seed0
description: Multipler composition test (load-bearing single-floor invariant). Cultist has VulnerablePower(2), player has WeakPower(2); player attacks Cultist for 6 raw → composed mul = (3/2) * (3/4) = 9/8 → 6 * 9 / 8 = 54/8 = 6.75 → floor 6. Cultist HP 48 - 6 = 42. Diverges from per-stage flooring (which would give 6→9 vuln→6.75 weak→6, same here, but the audit showed ~12.5% of inputs flip; this fixture documents the canonical multi-multiplier path.
